puzzles.text: White to move, and the rook eyes the pawn on h3 with some concern. 'Should I capture it right away?' it wonders, as the thought of promotion looms. But then it clicks: the pawn isn't as dangerous as it seems. Even if that little black soldier starts running, the rook can still defend from behind just in time.
